flash-lite.earring: Floating hoop; the bead does not connect.
flash-lite.star: Recognizable five-point star, with uneven proportions.
flash-lite.logo: Readable NOVA text, but the white silhouette does not form an N.

deepseek.earring: Coherent angular hoop, closer to an open cuff.
deepseek.star: A decagon. It has no concave star valleys.
deepseek.logo: Best badge in the blind review. Clear N and spacious layout, after a retry.

glm.earring: Disconnected rods instead of a continuous hoop.
glm.star: Six points instead of the requested five.
glm.logo: Strong, readable badge. The star sits close to the N.

qwen.earring: Distracting black blocks. Its 33.5 mm length exceeds the 28 mm brief.
qwen.star: Malformed outline, about 6.2 by 9.7 mm instead of roughly 18 mm.
qwen.logo: Readable wordmark, but dark seams break the N.

gemini.earring: Best earring appearance. Convincing pendant details; hardware remains approximate.
gemini.star: Best five-point silhouette. Clean and balanced.
gemini.logo: The gold rim adds polish, but dark seams weaken the N.
